text:
incident-bot: [PAGER] Spike in gateway 5xx + timeouts in us-central. Source: inference-gateway -> prefix-cache layer. Error codes: 502/504/524. Paging oncall-raj.
oncall-raj: I'm up. Joining.
maria: I see latency + error spike starting at 21:03 UTC, correlates with prefix-cache evictions. evictions/sec ~ 950 on shard-12.
eng-kai: Any recent cache config changes? TTLs, compaction, or eviction policy tweaks?
oncall-raj: No config pushes in last 2h. But there's a background compaction job scheduled at 21:00. Could be related.
sre-bot: quick health dump: ```text
shard=12 evictions=942 rate=15.7% miss_rate=0.64 checksums_fail=18
heap_free=120MB rss=3.2GB restarts=1 last_compaction=21:00:07Z
```
maria: Checksums failing flags possible corruption. When cache returns bad entries, proxy falls back to KV readthrough which is saturating backend, causing timeouts.
customer-success-amy: We're seeing customer incidents in Zendesk from three enterprise tenants; requests timing out. Need to update status page.
eng-kai: Short-term mitigation options: 1) Pause compaction job for affected shard(s), 2) Put shard-12 into read-through-only to avoid serving corrupted entries, 3) Temporarily increase backend kv pool size / spawn extra read replicas for readthrough flood, 4) Apply selective circuit-breaker on gateway for keys hitting shard-12.
oncall-raj: Let's do steps 1 and 2 immediately. Who can pause compactor?
maria: I can flip compaction off for shard-12: `./jobs/admin toggle-compactor --shard=12 --off --reason="incident-1777778888"`
incident-bot: Action queued: toggle-compactor run id comp-1777778888-1
maria: Executed, compaction paused.
sre-bot: compaction paused confirmed. Evictions still high but no new compaction churn.
eng-kai: I'll flip read-mode to readthrough for shard-12: `./cachectl shard-mode --shard=12 --mode=readthrough --env=prod`
eng-kai: Executed. Observability: prefixed_read_hits drop to near-zero for shard-12. Backend kv QPS rising ~3x.
maria: Backend metric: kv read latency p95 climbed to 1.3s immediately. We need to throttle gateway retries to avoid amplifying timeouts.
oncall-raj: Reduce gateway retry to 1 and enable per-key fast-fail for shard-12 pattern. `gatewayctl set retry_budget 1 --scope=shard12`
eng-kai: Done. Also opening additional read replica nodes: infra scaling requested - `infractl scale kv-readers +6` (estimated ready in 90s).
customer-success-amy: Posting customer notice draft: "We're investigating elevated errors causing timeouts; mitigation in progress; may see increased latencies for some requests." Want approval to publish now.
oncall-raj: Publish now. Add note we'll update in 30m.
incident-bot: Status page update posted: https://status.redwood.ai/incidents/1777778888 - note: mitigation in progress.
eng-kai: After readthrough switch, gateway 5xx down from 4.6% -> 1.1% within 2m, but backend errors (524) persist for some heavy keys.
maria: We found one proxy instance (proxy-12-3) with repeated checksum errors and high GC pauses. Logs: ```
[proxy-12-3] 2026-04-02T21:04:12Z checksum mismatch key=prefix:user:987654
[proxy-12-3] 2026-04-02T21:04:14Z heap compaction paused for 1200ms
[proxy-12-3] 2026-04-02T21:04:16Z evicting 450 entries in burst
```
noncall-raj: I'll cordon proxy-12-3 from serving and restart it to clear state. `infractl cordon proxy-12-3 && infractl restart instance proxy-12-3`
eng-kai: Restart done. After restart, checksum errors decreased, evictions stabilized to ~200/s.
maria: Backend read latency still elevated but trending down as new replicas come up.
customer-success-amy: Customers updated. Reduced inbound incident reports.
eng-kai: Next steps: schedule a background scrub of shard-12 to verify cache integrity and remove stale corrupted entries. Command: `maintenance run scrub --shard=12 --mode=verify+fix --snapshot=true`
noncall-raj: Run scrub during low traffic window; start in 45m so we don't overload backend. Meanwhile, keep readthrough mode until scrub completes.
sre-bot: Suggestion: add a temporary prefix-filter in gateway to route requests for high-traffic keys away from shard-12 (shard affinity override) to reduce hotspots.
maria: Implemented shard-affinity override for prefixes matching `user:` heavy keys. `gatewayctl set-affinity --prefix="user:" --target=shard-8`
eng-kai: Affinity override in place. Traffic for heavy keys moved; backend load spread. KV p95 back to 380ms.
noncall-raj: Triage: probable cause = compaction + GC pressure on proxy instances leading to partial entry corruption and eviction storms, triggering high miss rates and backend overload.
customer-success-amy: Recommend follow-up: customer RCA note and timeline.
eng-kai: I'll prepare a mitigation-runbook update: include pause-compaction, shard readthrough, cordon-restart, affinity override, and scrub procedure.
maria: I'll collect logs and checksums before and after scrub for postmortem.
incident-bot: If 5xx < baseline for 20m and no regressions, paging will be closed.
eng-kai: Observability: 5xx at 0.5% and stable for 12m. I'll keep watch.
customer-success-amy: Posting final customer update: "Services stabilized; mitigation applied; engineering doing deeper investigation and scrub. We'll share a full postmortem."
noncall-raj: Handoff: maria will take watch for the next 3 hours and own postmortem. I'm off.
maria: Acknowledged, taking watch. I'll resume scrub at 22:30 UTC and update channel with results.
incident-bot: oncall-raj acknowledged. Incident moved to monitoring at 1777779250.
